versions.changelog:
arb-spread 1.0.0

- Initial release of the arb-spread signal.
- Provides real-time arbitrage spread data between Kraken and Hyperliquid, sourced directly from APEX Runner's live system.
- No registration or subscription required; pay-per-call with EVM wallet and USDC on Base mainnet.
- Early adopter discount tiers enabled automatically.
- Includes usage instructions, example responses, and related signal links.
